saw_lines: Watch buyers choose one piece to say who they are, then wear it for years. Price comes second, after the dial.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a buyer decides if the discount is worth a click.
Your site offers a first order discount and free shipping, yet 0 of 10 copy ads mention either one. Put the discount in the first line of three new ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers a first order discount, but 0 of 10 copy ads mention it, so a new buyer has no reason to click. Open three new ads with that discount in the first line and on the creative.

None of your 29 live ads carries a proof number, so a stranger has nothing concrete to trust before clicking. Collect one real figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.
19 of your 29 live ads are catalog feed ads with no story, so a scrolling viewer has no reason to stop. Add three story ads on the Multifort TV and the Ocean Star 200 to give the feed a reason.

Your 10 copy ads open with 9 different stories, and the biggest opens only 2. Each angle is spread thin, so none is tested against a clear rival. Pick the two strongest openings and build the next batch from them.

ads_1: Multifort TV story ads opening on the first order discount, tested against Ocean Star
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
